display.purpose: Wordmark and the two section titles only -- never at data-dense sizes.

body.purpose: Filters, table cells, panel prose, buttons -- everything data-dense.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels: column headers, panel titles, chips, result count, topnav.

motion.name: torch-flicker
motion.value: steps(1) 1.6s infinite, hand-placed irregular opacity keyframes (6%, 11%, 19%, 27%, 33%, 41%, 52%, 58%, 69%, 74%, 83%, 89%)
motion.purpose: Live-status dot -- jump-cut flicker meant to read as a torch/redstone lamp, not a smooth pulse.

motion.name: ticker-scroll
motion.value: translateX(0) to translateX(-50%), linear, duration scales with item count (items * 4s)
motion.purpose: Seamless looping marquee of the board's own current top listings.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button -- ink surface, inverts to signal green on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: var(--rule) solid var(--black); background: var(--black); color: var(--white); height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button -- paper surface, fully inverts to ink on hover (mirror of Primary's hover, not a separate treatment).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border: var(--rule) solid var(--black); background: var(--white); color: var(--black); height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background: var(--black); color: var(--white); border-color: var(--black); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Active single-value filter pill (e.g. the company filter) -- green by default, inverts to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--green); color: var(--white); border: var(--rule) solid var(--green); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { background: var(--black); border-color: var(--black); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Search/keyword filter field -- 2px ink border, inset green focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="SEARCH TITLE, COMPANY, LOCATION…" />
components.css: .ds-input { border: var(--rule) solid var(--black); background: var(--white); color: var(--black); padding: 9px 10px; height: 38px; width: 100%; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 13px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: One tile in the top metrics strip -- part of the black-hairline card grid, not individually bordered.
components.css: .ds-metric-card { background: var(--white); color: var(--black); padding: 18px 16px; min-height: 116px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-metric-label { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--grey); } .ds-metric-value { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--black); }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: Signature live-status indicator -- square block, jump-cut torch flicker while live, goes solid alert-red with animation killed outright when stale.
components.css: .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--green); display: inline-block; animation: ds-torch-flicker 1.6s steps(1) infinite; } .ds-status-dot.ds-stale { background: var(--red); animation: none; } @keyframes ds-torch-flicker { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 6% { opacity: 0.8; } 11% { opacity: 1; } 19% { opacity: 0.55; } 27% { opacity: 1; } 33% { opacity: 0.85; } 41% { opacity: 1; } 52% { opacity: 0.7; } 58% { opacity: 1; } 69% { opacity: 0.9; } 74% { opacity: 1; } 83% { opacity: 0.6; } 89% { opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview: A market terminal, not a careers site: white paper, black ink, a single green reserved for the one number or status that matters right now, and a scrolling headline strip up top like a ticker tape. Everything reads as a live instrument panel over a job market, not as a brand experience -- density and legibility win over warmth every time there's a conflict between them. The one indulgence is a single pixel-grid display face, kept to two places (the wordmark and the two section titles) so it reads as a signature, not a typeface choice bleeding into body text.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, two-tone (white/black) surfaces with color used as signal, not decoration
Depth built entirely from 2px black hairline grids, never shadows
One pixel-grid display face for brand moments; Helvetica for everything data-dense
Light/dark is a total token inversion, not a second palette
A live-status vocabulary (the ticker, the status-dot torch flicker) borrowed from terminals/dashboards, not marketing sites

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Green marks exactly one "this matters" element at a time. If everything is green, nothing is -- it never appears as decoration, only on live status, primary metrics, and the handful of buttons/links that actually do something.

rules.name: The Straight Swap Rule
rules.body: Light and dark mode are not two palettes -- --white/--black (and everything derived from them) simply invert their hex values under [data-theme="dark"]. Every rule in the system reads the token, never a literal hex, so the swap is total; a hardcoded #fff/#000 anywhere breaks dark mode for that one element.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Helvetica (--font) carries everything dense; Monocraft (--font-display) is reserved for exactly two brand-level spots. No third typeface is part of the system.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The black rules between cards are the only depth cue this design uses. A shadow anywhere is a bug, not a style choice.

dos: Do keep border-radius at 0 everywhere, no exceptions.
Do build all depth/separation from the 2px black rule grid or a 1px hairline -- never a shadow.
Do read every color from a var(--token), never a literal hex, so the light/dark straight-swap stays total.
Do keep green to exactly one "this matters most" element at a time.
Do keep Monocraft scoped to the wordmark and the two section titles only -- never at data-dense sizes.
Do let --gutter's clamp() drive side padding instead of a fixed max-width container, so the page keeps scaling at ultra-wide widths.
Do give any element holding an unbreakable-width child (a curl command, a long label) min-width: 0.
donts: Don't add a second accent color. Signal Green is the only one; a second dilutes what green means everywhere else.
Don't use Alert Red outside the offline-status dot and the error-state banner -- it has exactly two meanings today.
Don't introduce a third typeface without folding it into the Two-Voice Rule as a named, scoped exception -- an unscoped one-off is exactly how "two voices" quietly becomes three.
Don't reach for box-shadow for elevation, ever, even subtly -- the one prior violation (a smoothly-pulsing circular status dot) was treated as a bug and corrected, not kept as a soft exception.
